Focus on testing using Playwright MCP. Generate test reports.

A few principles to follow:
- Start small and build up your test suite gradually.
- Take your time to think
- Use headed mode
- Use Playwright's built-in test runner for writing and executing tests.
- Use Page Object Model (POM) to encapsulate page interactions.
- Use descriptive comments and meaningful test names.
- Organize tests in a way that reflects the structure of your application.
- Use fixtures to set up common test scenarios.
